title: Create and dispatch AISH work
description: Use when work must run on AISH runners: create or approve AISH jobs, add intake reference files or transcripts, run a cockpit execution session (sessão de execução: plan, dispatch, pause, checkpoint). Not for job evidence (use lpm-aish-delivery) or commit-tracked work (use lpm-deliver-activity).
doneWhen: The job or session is in the requested state (queued behind a closed gate, approved by the owner, or dispatched) and a re-read shows it; an approved job stays `status` queued with `executionGate.runnerMayExecute` true until a runner leases it.
authorityCeiling: Agents create, lease, plan, dispatch and request; job/plan approval, checkpoint resolution and Copilot decisions are [O]; funding is owner-only in lpm-ai-cost.
jobs: create an AISH analysis job for activity <issueId>
cria um job AISH de teste para a atividade <id> no repositório <repo>
aprova o job AISH <jobId> (sou o dono)
run this objective through the AISH cockpit: plan, readiness, owner approval, dispatch
pausa a sessão de execução <sessionId> e retoma depois do checkpoint
anexa este áudio como referência do job e registra a transcrição
retry the failed nodes of AISH session <sessionId>
propose a Copilot action to summarize the project's AISH jobs

notFor.when: work done in Claude Code, Codex or an editor, tracked by the commit trailer
closing, proving, auditing or releasing AISH work (delivery artifacts, DoD audit, release packages, disposition)
installing or starting runners and hosts, leasing or executing jobs, submitting job evidence
AISH budgets, funding a job, pools or AI cost
WhatsApp or operational intake entries to route or triage
